tabs.intro:
[[Alexander the Great]] kept Homer's 《Iliad》 at his side on the battlefield.
[[Napoleon]] read 《The Sorrows of Young Werther》 seven times and carried it on his Egyptian campaign.
[[Lincoln]] was immersed in 《Shakespeare's Plays》, reciting lines and frequenting the theater.

What works captured the hearts of great figures, and what single line changed their lives? Those traces continue to inspire us thousands of years later.

So we set out to follow those traces.
